Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in the initial task decomposition and information gathering phase by failing to verify the identity of "Sachin Warrier." The search results from the first WebSurfer step clearly showed multiple individuals named Sachin Warrier working for different companies (DreamPay, Naviguard, UnitedHealth Group). The Planner incorrectly assumed the first result (DreamPay) was the correct one without cross-referencing or verifying which specific Sachin Warrier the user was referring to. This premature assumption led to the wrong company being selected, which subsequently resulted in an incorrect headquarters location.
